Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for the sales of wine at the legislative gift center.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sales of wine at the legislative gift center;adding new sections to chapter 44.73 RCW; and adding a new section tochapter 66.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the production ofwine grapes in the state is an important segment of Washingtonagriculture as evidenced by the continued investments made by the statein developing the wine industry, including the creation of viticultureand enology programs at Washington State University. The legislaturefurther finds that the promotion and sale of Washington wine at thelegislative gift center is harmonious with the purpose of the giftcenter, which is to promote the state and the goods produced around thestate. Therefore, the legislature intends to allow the legislativegift center to sell wine produced in Washington to visitors of legaldrinking age.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Nothing in this title shall apply to or prevent the legislative p. 1 HB 1415gift center created in chapter 44.73 RCW from selling at retail foroffpremises consumption wine produced in Washington by a licenseddomestic winery.

The legislative gift center is authorized tosell at retail for offpremises consumption wine produced in Washingtonby a licensed domestic winery. Wine sold by the legislative giftcenter must: (1) Be sold to individuals twentyone years of age orolder; (2) be sold for personal use and not for resale; and (3) havebeen purchased from a licensed wine distributor or from a manufacturerauthorized to distribute wine of its own production. The legislative gift center must collect and remit to thedepartment of revenue all applicable state and local taxes on sales ofwine.
Sections 1 and 3 of this act are each addedto chapter 44.73 RCW.
